title: Prior Labs, TabPFN-3.5: Technical Report (abstract page)
note: Fetched abstract page. v1 15 Sep 2026, v2 22 Sep, v3 3 Nov 2026; cs.LG; 47 authors. A tabular foundation model release. Its only forecasting statement: the gains carry over to the task-specific harnesses, with stronger time-series forecasting. No forecasting number and no load or energy result in the abstract.

title: TabPFN-3.5 report, full text v3: fev-bench (appendix C.6)
note: Appendix C.6 read. TabPFN-3.5 run through TabPFN-TS on fev-bench (100 tasks, skill over seasonal naive, SQL and MASE) with the TabPFN-TS-3 entry's settings (context 32768, 12 seasonal periods). Places sixth of 29 methods, 1.1 points above TabPFN-TS-3 at 2.4 times its speed, behind TimesFM-3, two Chronos-2 variants, TiRex-2 and Toto-2.0. Scores are in Figure 21 only (an image).

title: TabPFN-3.5 report, full text v3: summary of results and licence (sections 2, 4)
note: Sections 2 and 4 read by keyword. The time-series claim is one bullet: the general checkpoint, with no time-series fine-tuning, beats TabPFN-TS-3 on fev-bench. No electricity or load result, no covariate analysis. Code Apache-2.0; 3.5 and 3.5-Fast weights under a non-commercial licence; Plus and Thinking not open. 3.5 is up to 2x slower than TabPFN-3 on large tables.

title: PriorLabs/tabpfn-time-series (repository README)
note: Fetched (cached copy, about 15 Nov 2026). Since v1.3.0 the package uses TabPFN-3.5 by default, locally and in the cloud; TabPFN-TS-3 stays available. Univariate target history plus known-future covariates (weather forecasts named); past-only and static covariates are dropped. Cloud client is the default engine. Code Apache-2.0. Local mode needs licence acceptance.

title: PriorLabs/tabpfn-time-series (README: known-covariate lag features)
note: Default features now add, per numeric known covariate, lag 1, a seasonal lag and a one-season trailing mean. On the 25 fev-bench tasks with numeric known covariates this is said to lower SQL by 4.5% on the default v3.5 model (21 of 25 better, worst +1.5%), most on temperature-driven load tasks. No per-task table or script on the page.

title: PriorLabs/tabpfn-time-series releases
note: Fetched. v1.3.0 (tag 17 Sep 2026; the README news line says 15 Sep) makes TabPFN-3.5 the default in local and cloud mode, needs tabpfn 9.0.0 or later, and shows how to keep the TabPFN-TS-3 checkpoint. v1.4.0 (28 Oct 2026) adds the known-covariate lag feature as first default feature and CUDA compilation by default.

title: TABPFN-3.5 Non-Commercial License (weights licence)
note: Fetched, read by keyword. Use only for non-commercial purposes: testing, evaluation, research, internal benchmarking, on private or public data, if results do not feed commercial decisions, client deliverables or paid services. Outputs carry the same limit. No hosting as a service. Licensee must act in a professional capacity (not a consumer).

title: PriorLabs/TabPFN (repository README)
note: Fetched. GPU recommended; on CPU TabPFN-3.5 allows up to 5,000 samples unless an override is set, and is described as slow. Weights download needs licence acceptance at the Prior Labs site, or a token for headless use; data stay local and offline use works after download. Default model is 3.5; code Apache-2.0, weights licensed separately.
